commands.name: list-products
commands.summary: List all tracked products (slug, label, category, tags, aliases)

commands.name: export-products-full
commands.summary: Dump all products with full details including every release cycle (large response)

commands.name: get-product
commands.summary: Get a product's metadata: label, category, tags, aliases, identifiers, version command, links

commands.name: list-releases
commands.summary: List all release cycles of a product with release, LTS, end-of-active-support and EOL dates

commands.name: get-latest-release
commands.summary: Get the latest release cycle of a product with its support and EOL dates

commands.name: get-release
commands.summary: Get one release cycle of a product (e.g. python 3.12) with its support and EOL status and dates

commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List product categories (e.g. framework, server-app, database, lang, os, service)

commands.name: list-tags
commands.summary: List all product tags (e.g. amazon, linux-distribution, java-distribution)

commands.name: list-products-by-tag
commands.summary: List products that have a given tag

commands.name: list-identifier-types
commands.summary: List supported product identifier types (purl, cpe, ...)

commands.name: list-identifiers
commands.summary: List all identifiers of a given type (e.g. CPE or purl strings) mapped to product slugs; use it to resolve a CPE/purl to a product

commands.name: list-new-products
commands.summary: Recently added products, newest first (Atom feed)

commands.name: list-product-events
commands.summary: Timeline of a product's release and end-of-life events (Atom feed)
